blocks.body: A TV commercial for the National Bank of Iraq's Visa credit card, blending cinematic storytelling with everyday Iraqi life.

blocks.title: NBI — Credit Card Campaign | TV Commercial

blocks.body: Directed by Rafat Mhalla and Mohammad Jalal

The commercial follows three friends playing dominoes. One of them is constantly frustrated by hidden charges and subscriptions draining his money — until the NBI Visa credit card offers a solution that gives back instead of taking away.

The visual treatment draws on warm, naturalistic lighting and a cinematic colour palette to ground the story in a familiar Iraqi setting. Dutch angles and tight close-ups heighten the character's tension, while the domino motif threads through every frame as a visual metaphor.

As Creative Director at Vision House, I led the campaign concept, visual treatment and film direction alongside Mohammad Jalal. From scripting and storyboarding through to the final cut, we shaped every detail of the commercial's cinematic language.
